label: 2023 FIVB Women's Volleyball Challenger Cup — Laval, France
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-6 Phase A (AUD1 2026-08-23). Capture: Wikipedia action=raw 2 chunks + FIVB schedule P2 PDFs + Volleyball World reports. Host FRA; champion FRA earned 2024 VNL place (replacing CRO). First appearances not applicable (all returning). Bracket spine exact: F winners (FRA) == SF winners; 3P (COL) == SF loser. No source defects.

provenance.note: WO-VB-6 Phase A final batch (Challenger Cup 2023/2024). Discontinuation adjudicated: both 2024 edition pages print 'fifth and last edition'; 2024 FIVB presser states champion joins expanded VNL from 2025 via direct EX mechanism — no Challenger Cup from 2025. Ranking-entry wrinkles 2024: Ukraine-M lost bronze (4th) yet still entered VNL-2025 via ranking; Belgium-W lost bronze (4th) yet entered VNL-2025 via ranking. Source defects: none new; all P2 IDs unique (no 16758-class duplication). Bracket spine exact: F winners == SF fields; 3P == SF losers; QF winners == SF fields.
provenance.raw_source: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw, 2 chunks per page) backed by per-row official FIVB Volleyball Challenge Cup schedule pages (P2 PDF links) and Volleyball World report links. All 32 rows have unique P2 vis IDs. 2023 host QAT / FRA; 2024 host CHN / PHI; single-city venues (Doha / Laval / Linyi / Manila).
